name: it003_L028_Y047_M006
reason: Material L028 (M55J/PAEK, E1 310 GPa): the five lightest predicted-feasible designs all use it; its LBA moment is 1.5x L038's at equal thickness (calibration set). Geometry M006: omega with the most buckling margin in TOP; it001 verified its static model in Abaqus (agree, FE/Timoshenko consistent); its design mesh (2.7 mm) runs B on the 4 mm coarse mesh, unlike C005 (4.5 mm design mesh; it002's C008 B took 85 min and stalled). Layup Y047 [0/45/0/45/0] (0.175 mm): the 5 plies are needed for the 50 kN mm lateral moment (screen M_loc 70,180 vs 50,000, +40% margin against the LBA-to-B knockdown, vs +3% for TOP #1 L028/Y024/C005 at 1.7% less mass); +-45 plies add shear stiffness (k_cal 27.2 vs 25 N/mm with Timoshenko).
